## 1. Intake and AI classification
The app posts the request here. Gemini labels type, urgency and confidence; code validates it and picks the branch.

## 2. One path per branch
Each branch drafts its own reply and applies its own steps, priority and follow-up. Low confidence goes to human review.

## 3. Respond, notify and email
Returns the full result to the app, posts the team notification to Slack and emails the customer reply (Mailtrap). Held replies are not emailed here.

## 5. Approved replies
When a person approves a held reply in the app, the app calls this endpoint and the email is sent.

## 4. 2-hour follow-up
Waits up to the follow-up time. If the app resumes it early (case resolved) it stops; otherwise it drafts a customer update (complaints and urgent) and reminds the team in Slack.
